WM_SIZE also precedes WM_DESTROY, because VC6 emits case blocks in source order and the original puts the size block at +113 and the destroy block at +182. Code is now 844 bytes, the same extent as the original, with the jump table starting exactly where the original's does at 0x0040152C; 276 instructions against 279. The residual is prologue register ordering and the high half of the packed size, which VC6 folds to test eax,0xffff0000 however it is written - an in-place shift through a local gives the same mask
